id: title:gantoine:honour public image push paused for credentials service and agent proxy

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the GitHub Actions workflow configuration for pushing container images to the public GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io). This could allow PostHog operations to pause public image pushes while potentially retaining private registry access or skipping the push entirely, depending on workflow configuration.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check for a GitHub Actions variable PUBLIC_IMAGE_PUSH_PAUSED to the ghcr.io push-to-ghcr parameter, allowing the workflow to skip pushing to GitHub Container Registry if the variable is set to 'true'.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog operations to pause pushing container images to the public ghcr.io registry while still potentially pushing to private registries or skipping the push entirely, depending on workflow configuration.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check to the docker login action, preventing authentication and subsequent push to ghcr.io if PUBLIC_IMAGE_PUSH_PAUSED is set to 'true'.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents the CI workflow from attempting to authenticate with and push to the ghcr.io registry when the pause variable is active, avoiding unnecessary API calls or potential failures.

observations.behavior: Adds the PUBLIC_IMAGE_PUSH_PAUSED variable to the environment of the build step, making it available to subsequent shell commands. P1.F2.H4 adds a conditional check to skip publishing the ghcr.io alias if the variable is set to 'true'.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to skip creating a public alias for the credentials service image on ghcr.io while still publishing to other registries, supporting a strategy where the public image is not pushed or aliased.
